purpose: Design the experimental campaign that tests whether orientation coherence narrows topological organization variance.

statement_under_test.candidate: Var(T | high C_orient) < Var(T | low C_orient)
statement_under_test.interpretation: Orientation coherence functions as a topological selector.

failure_conditions: Variance reduction explained entirely by residue controls

success_condition.statement: Variance reduction persists across controls and exceeds minimum effect threshold.
